name: FS Admin Menu
author: Diego Versiani

sections.description:
Groups the admin menu items into expansible sections easier to understand and find what you need, no matter what plugins or themes are installed.

Many plugins and themes add their own menu items in different positions on the WordPress admin menu, each one tries to compete for your attention and the admin menu can easily get messy.

This plugin will organize the admin menu into various groups and show the important menu items at the top. If you have WooCommerce installed, that will be the “Store” group with the most important e-commerce actions, otherwise, the “Content” group will be displayed first with the most important content creation and management menu items always easy to access.

Translations

We understand this is very important to all users worldwide.

This plugin is fully localized and translatable using the built-in WordPress functions, and currently translated into 83 languages out of the 132 languages supported by WordPress, which should include all the most used languages. All translations are done automatically through DeepL or Google Translate as available on those services.

Some translations errors are expected to happen. Please contact our support and we will evaluate and fix these errors.
